statements.notes: For over 20 years, Troponin Nutrition has been improving athletes through smarter nutrition. Every single product that bears the T mark has been strategically developed to give you the tools needed to succeed.

Directions
Mix 1 serving (1 scoop) into 8-16 ounces of water or your favorite beverage and drink 1-2 times daily.

Warning
For use by healthy adults only, not recommended for persons under the age of 18.
Keep out of the reach of children.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Do not use if you are pregnant or nursing.

Seek advice from a healthcare professional before taking if you have any preexisting medical condition to ensure it is safe to take this product. In case of accidental overdose, contact a poison control center immediately.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Suggested use: Intended for use in healthy adults and as a part of a healthy, balanced diet and exercise program.
Tip: Mix with your favorite protein shake, pre-workout, or intra-workout drink for an extra performance boost.
